notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.9 - new If-click step (conditional click for popup handling). Add it like a normal Click step: give it the popup button's CSS selector and a presence window (default 1 second). If the element appears within the window it gets clicked and the flow continues; if it never appears the flow continues with no error. The branch taken (clicked / not present) is recorded per row in the step trail and in fieldsWritten, so it is never silent. Existing flows are unaffected.
